heading_en: Application for Approval to Use the ILM
summary_ja: ILM利用の承認申請書の記載事項と、算出方法ごとに添付すべき書類を定める。
summary_en: Sets out the contents of the application for approval to use the ILM and the documents to be attached for each calculation method.
paragraphs: An Ultimate Designated Parent Company seeking the approval under paragraph (1) or (2) of the preceding Article shall submit to the Commissioner of the Financial Services Agency a written application for approval stating the following matters. (i) Trade name. (ii) The name and title of the person responsible for ascertaining and managing the consolidated capital adequacy ratio.

The following documents shall be attached to the written application for approval in the preceding paragraph, according to the category of case set out in each of the following items. (i) Where the ILM is calculated by the method provided in Article 284, paragraph (1), item (i): the following documents. (a) A written statement of reasons. (b) A curriculum vitae of the person responsible provided for in item (ii) of the preceding paragraph. (c) A document stating the date on which use of the ILM is to begin, the scope of application and the trial calculation value of the ILM. (d) A document stating the trial calculation values of the operational risk equivalent amount and the consolidated capital adequacy ratio relating to the trial calculation value of the ILM. (e) A document showing conformity with the approval standards. (f) A document stating any other matters that would serve as a reference. (ii) Where the ILM is calculated by the method of using a conservative estimate: the following documents. (a) A written statement of reasons. (b) A curriculum vitae of the person responsible provided for in item (ii) of the preceding paragraph. (c) The method of calculating the conservative estimate and the procedural rules. (d) A document stating the date on which use of the conservative estimate is to begin, the scope of application and the estimated value. (e) A document stating the trial calculation values of the operational risk equivalent amount and the consolidated capital adequacy ratio relating to the conservative estimate. (f) A document stating any other matters that would serve as a reference.
